verdict.rationale: Maritime documents bring-your-own-image: any Docker image that implements its three-endpoint contract becomes an agent, and repos with a Dockerfile, including private GitHub repos, are built and run with live build logs. Templates are cloneable agent packages that publishers can share by link or through a public library, which covers custom templates. Missing for 10: detailed docs on authoring and publishing custom templates, specifics of the three-endpoint contract requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
